name: rivetos
description: RivetOS extensions for Cursor Grok Bot: persistent cross-agent memory (recall + gated write tools) backed by the shared RivetOS datahub.

plugins.name: rivet-memory-grokbot
plugins.description: RivetOS memory for Grok Bot. MCP recall (memory_search/browse/stats/get_full, wiki) plus gated write tools (memory_append, memory_ingest_session) against the same Postgres store every Rivet agent shares. Requires a built RivetOS checkout at /opt/rivetos (or RIVETOS_ROOT) and ~/.rivetos/.env with RIVETOS_PG_URL.
